data.title: Hallway
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Can you keep something quiet? I'm pregnant, and I haven't told our manager yet; I'm waiting until after the twelve-week scan. Speaker 2: Congratulations! My lips are sealed. Speaker 1: The thing is, I'll be on leave in March, so could you lead the March workshop instead of me? Speaker 2: Yes, I'll take the March workshop. Speaker 1: Thank you. I'll send you my slides next month.
